notes: Aurora holds one notes-receivable account. The current/non-current split comes from the loan master, carried on the line.
Facilities overhead booked to the corporate facilities department is absorbed into cost of sales.

Supply chain and warehouse overhead is consumables, not indirect labour. The rule is on the department CODE and not on its function: D105 and D110 share the indirect-operations function but belong in indirect labour.

THE MATERIAL MAPPING PROBLEM. Aurora books all payroll to one account whether the labour is direct, indirect or SG&A, so gross margin is not derivable from the account code alone. See ADR-0007 and CTL-MAP-04.
Field and project labour is direct labour delivered on site.
Indirect operations labour is absorbed as production overhead.
Benefits follow the payroll they burden: the same department set as 6100.
Payroll taxes follow the payroll they burden.
Contract labour in production and field departments is a cost of sale.
Plant and warehouse occupancy is absorbed into cost of sales.
Consulting booked to the transformation department is non-recurring and belongs in the add-back block.
Corporate development consulting is transaction cost.
Aurora has a single interest account; the instrument split comes from the debt master, keyed on the journal reference.
An unrealised revaluation is presented below EBITDA and is a permitted covenant add-back (CA-030).
Land is not depreciated and must not sit inside the building class.
Sable has no separate freight revenue account, so reimbursables that are not freight fall to other operating revenue.

Safety training for field crews is a cost of delivering the work. The chart narrative enumerates D200, D205 and D215; the rule is expressed on the department FUNCTION because that enumeration is an incomplete statement of the same idea -- D210 is also a field department.
Crew vehicles are equipment used to deliver the service; management vehicles are not.
Kestrel books contract assets and prepayments to one accrued-income account.

THE GERMAN TOTAL-COST-METHOD PROBLEM. Under the Gesamtkostenverfahren the movement in finished goods is presented above the revenue line as part of Gesamtleistung. Under the group's cost-of-sales presentation it belongs inside cost of sales. The AMOUNT is unchanged -- a credit stays a credit -- but its caption moves from income to a credit within cost of sales, which is the sign reversal the chart narrative describes. See CTL-MAP-08 and docs/mapping-engine.md.
Own work capitalised is the second total-cost-method item; it is credited against production overhead rather than shown as revenue.
Sonstige betriebliche Ertraege is a catch-all under German GAAP and has to be decomposed before it can be reported.

The chart narrative reads 'partner_bu = IS -> service revenue', which is an incomplete statement of the same idea: what the Kestrel entities sell to a Flow Control or Aftermarket partner is product, and everything else is a service recharge. IC-SV-03 recharges Tyneside services to Vector B.V., an Engineered Systems partner, and is a service sale. Expressed the other way round the rule is complete and matches the intercompany matrix.
A nature-of-expense chart cannot separate direct from indirect labour, so the cost centre carries the split.
Affiliate interest must leave the third-party interest accounts or consolidated net interest is overstated (CTL-IC-05).
